description: A vision model is sometimes confidently wrong, so it never decides alone. SigLIP watches every frame. Gemma checks two steps in parallel. A deterministic rule engine owns the state, and a stop needs two agreeing checks on different frames. In simulation, with a model that is wrong five percent of the time, false stops on correct trainees fall from fourteen percent to zero.
